content:
maria nguyen: FYI CI is failing for payment-service PR #452 — SAST rule 'crypto-weak-usage' started flagging `AES-CBC` usage. It didn't fail yesterday. Looks noisy and blocking the deploy.

jason cole: :eyes: can you paste the SAST output and the CI agent logs? Thread TS?

maria nguyen: gist link... (redacted) but key bits:
```
ERROR: scanner: failed to access key for repo payment-service: kms.Decrypt: AccessDenied
scanner: rule crypto-weak-usage matched file payment/encrypt.go: uses deprecated IV handling
```
CI shows KMS Decrypt denied at 12:03 UTC. We rolled RBAC for build-agent role earlier today — could be related.

olivia park: Which scanner version? We had a rule update rolled yesterday to v2.3.0 that tightened crypto patterns.

dave li: Confirmed: rule pushed by vendor yesterday. It now flags patterns that previously were heuristics. But KMS access denied means the scanner couldn't fetch runtime config — that makes static hits noisier.

maria nguyen: @devsecops-bot can you check the KMS audit logs for the build-agent role around 12:03?

devsecops-bot: KMS audit: Principal build-agent@ci-system attempted Decrypt on projects/redwood/kms/keys/infra-key at 2026-03-01T12:03:02Z — DENIED (role: service-ci-build). IAM change: policy update 2026-03-01T11:58 by jason.cole.

jason cole: That matches the RBAC change I applied to remove ecsTask role binding temporarily. My bad — I was rotating role bindings for on-call. I'll revert.

maria nguyen: Reverting will unblock CI but we should also avoid noisy rule causing a full pipeline block. Proposal:
- revert RBAC now (temp fix)
- add evidence requirement for crypto-weak-usage (e.g., require proof-of-concept or linked eval) before failing pipeline
- add a non-blocking tag for vendor rule until we tune

olivia park: +1 on non-blocking. We should also add audit-forwarding for all KMS Deny events to sec-telemetry so triage can correlate automatically.

dave li: Ops playbook: if KMS denies cause scanner config fetch failure, scanner should default to 'lenient' mode and emit WARN not FAIL. I'll open PR to scanner repo.

maria nguyen: I'll revert RBAC now and follow up with a suppression request on the PR and open a Jira for tuning the rule and adding audit-forwarding.

oncall: Revert done. CI restarted, previous failures cleared.

maria nguyen: Thanks @oncall. Filing ticket: SEC-3379 with notes and attaching KMS audit snippet. @jason cole can you add a short blurb in the RBAC change description so we have context next time?

jason cole: Yup, adding note now. Sorry about the churn.

maria nguyen: No worries. We'll also schedule a quick sync w/ the vendor next Tue to discuss false positive rate on crypto rules.

dave li: Add me and olivia. I'll include proposed scanner fallback patch.

maria nguyen: End of thread.
